scope: native-v1 WCO-N-F07: a sender sequence of 2^40 through the patched SDK send path and the durable store

standard.name: IETF OSCORE
standard.summary: The Partial IV is at most 5 bytes, so a Sender Sequence Number reaching 2^40 cannot protect another message

source_identity.kind: exact source-file SHA-256; no source commit association asserted

assertions: A durable store opened with an exclusive boundary of 2^40 backs a public-API libcoap OSCORE client whose start sender sequence is 2^40
Three GET sends each return COAP_INVALID_MID, the bound UDP peer receives no datagram and the store boundary stays 2^40, because libcoap refuses before encrypting and never requests a reservation
A reservation past 2^40 returns WCO_STORE_EXHAUSTED and wco_store_code maps it to sequence_exhausted
The helper cannot reach this state: each context opens at sender sequence zero and is consumed on exit, so the corpus runner contract places F07 in this vector
unaccepted: The native worker maps a libcoap refusal at the sequence limit to its send failure code rather than sequence_exhausted; no helper context can reach that limit
The helper half of native-v1 F15
